parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set chassis fpc 0 pic 0 channelized-t1.explanation: Configure the chassis settings for a specific FPC (Flexible PIC Concentrator), PIC (Physical Interface Card), and set it to channelized-T1 mode

parameters.name: fpc number
parameters.explanation: The number of the FPC to be configured

parameters.name: pic number
parameters.explanation: The number of the PIC within the specified FPC to be configured

parameters.name: mode
parameters.explanation: The operation mode to set for the specified PIC, e.g., channelized-t1

set chassis fpc 0 pic 0 t1 1/0/0 channel.command: set chassis fpc 0 pic 0 t1 1/0/0 channel-group 1 timeslots 1-24
set chassis fpc 0 pic 0 t1 1/0/0 channel.template: set chassis fpc [parameter1] pic [parameter2] t1 [parameter3] channel-group [parameter4] timeslots [parameter5]
set chassis fpc 0 pic 0 t1 1/0/0 channel.explanation: Configure T1 interface channel group and timeslots on a specific FPC and PIC

parameters.name: timeslots range
parameters.explanation: Range of timeslots to be included in the channel group

set interfaces t1-1/0/0:1 framing extend.explanation: Configure the framing type for a specific T1 interface

parameters.name: interface name
parameters.explanation: The name of the T1 interface to be configured

parameters.name: framing type
parameters.explanation: The framing type to be set for the interface, e.g., extended-superframe

parameters.name: encapsulation type
